subject.title: feat(feishu): bot-to-bot conversation support with @mention handling

question: Should Feishu accept bot-authored group events by default when the include-bot scope is granted, or require an explicit allowBots mode before merge?
rationale: The PR adds an operator-visible config/default surface whose omitted value can change live bot-pair behavior and loop suppression; automation cannot choose that product posture for maintainers.

options.title: Preserve Default Accept
options.body: Keep omitted allowBots accepting bot-authored Feishu events to preserve current Feishu behavior, with loop protection as the upgrade guard.

options.title: Default To Mentions Only
options.body: Change the omitted/default posture to accept only bot-authored events that explicitly mention the OpenClaw bot, reducing surprise at the cost of stricter upgrade behavior.

options.title: Require Explicit Opt-In
options.body: Require allowBots: true or allowBots: "mentions" before processing bot-authored Feishu events, matching the most conservative safety posture.

recommendation.title: Preserve Default Accept
recommendation.body: Keep omitted allowBots accepting bot-authored Feishu events to preserve current Feishu behavior, with loop protection as the upgrade guard.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Feishu mention and reply-dispatcher ownership makes this the best available product/code routing candidate.
